A.name: Operating Liability Portfolio
A.purpose: Fund the ten $50,000 payments from 2033 to 2042.

B.name: Growth Portfolio
B.purpose: Grow capital before 2033 to raise what Laura can put toward the facility.

C.name: Flexibility / Residual Portfolio
C.purpose: Keep capital beyond the residency so one project does not absorb everything.

role_descriptions.CG: The spine of the growth sleeve. Broad, diversified, held for the whole run to 2033.
role_descriptions.SG: A researched individual position taken on top of the core, sized small on purpose.
role_descriptions.ID: Exposure outside the United States, held to reduce single-country dependence.
role_descriptions.LM: Dedicated to a specific $50,000 payment year. Certainty matters more than yield.
role_descriptions.LR: Short-dated and liquid. Covers timing, not growth.
role_descriptions.LG: Capital intended to stay invested after 2033 once the residency is funded.
role_descriptions.DA: Ballast. Expected to behave differently from equities in a drawdown.

registry.note: Fund facts that no keyless public API exposes: expense ratios, holdings, sector and country weights, defined maturity dates. Every entry carries the issuer page it should be checked against. PRD 11 puts issuer factsheets in tier 1, but a figure transcribed into this file has not been re-read from the issuer today, so the scoring engine treats these as tier 2 and the interface marks them for verification. Refresh before any committee decision.
registry.refresh_instruction: Open the issuer URL on the row, confirm expense ratio, AUM, holdings count and top ten weight, then update as_of.
